thread:
Maya: dropped a compact prototype for snooze visibility + playbook hover flow. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/preview-snooze-visibility :eyes:
Priya: nice iteration. two quick asks: (1) term: switch 'Mute' -> 'Snooze' everywhere. Ops consistently uses Snooze. (2) show expiry time in the pill e.g. 'Snoozed until 16:40' so users don't think it's permanent.
Alex: agree on Snooze. accessibility: any hover-only preview must have a keyboard-triggered equivalent. propose a small focusable 'Preview' button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Noor: perf note: lazy-load preview snippets on first hover/focus and cache per-alert with a 10min TTL. don't fire routing resolution for list virtualization renders.
Tess: contrast nit: pill foreground must be pure white on dark theme to hit 4.5:1. also ensure focus-visible outline is present. example CSS: `
.preview-btn:focus-visible{ outline: 3px solid #ffd166; outline-offset: 2px }
.snooze-pill{ background:#2b3746; color:#ffffff }
`
Alex: SR announcement: when a snooze is applied announce via live region: `aria-live="polite"` text 'Alert snoozed until 16:40 UTC'. Also for preview loads: 'Delivery preview loaded for alert <short id>'.
Maya: design intent: inline list shows metadata (playbook link + owner + last-run). hover/focus reveals a cached 200-char snippet. details rail has full editable playbook. I'll annotate figma with aria attributes.
Priya: delivery preview should show resolved endpoints first: 'Delivering to: #alerts, PagerDuty (svc-ops)'. include a smaller 'via: <rule-name>' line for debugging. that reduces confusion.
Noor: add a 'what-if' toggle to simulate alternate mappings (aria-pressed). must be keyboard operable and labelled.
Tess: mobile behaviour: on narrow widths convert hover preview to a tappable full-screen popover; ensure 44px minimum tap targets.
Alex: implementation detail: when preview is stale (mapping version changed) show inline warning 'Mapping changed  refresh preview' with a refresh button. keep refresh idempotent.
Maya: copy tweak: prefer active voice 'Delivering to:' vs 'Will notify:'. I'll update labels. also add tiny history row under details: 'Snoozed by A. Chen  2h ago'.
Priya: UX question: pill vs icon-only. my vote: text-first when space allows; icon-only fallback with aria-label for dense rows. screen reader gets full text via aria-label.
Noor: keyboard flow: popover should `role="dialog"` and trap focus. Escape closes and returns focus to opener. example markup suggestion: `<button aria-expanded='false' aria-controls='preview-<id>'>Preview</button>` then `<div role='dialog' id='preview-<id>' aria-modal='true'>...`
Tess: tiny CSS snippet for runbook toggle focus I've used elsewhere: `
.runbook-toggle:focus{ outline: 3px solid #ffb400; outline-offset: 2px; }
`
Alex: toast UX: include undo action for snooze: 'Snoozed until 16:40  Undo'. announce toast with role='status' so SR picks it up.
Maya: thanks  i'll push updated frames with annotations tonight. can we do a quick 25m sync tomorrow 11:15am for a11y + copy signoff?
Priya: works for me.
Noor: added. @ops-bot can you schedule and enable recording?
